title: Agents
description: Configure subagents with the same agent settings as Codex CLI.
timing: Agents run until they finish, fail, or are stopped. Waiting can time out without stopping an agent. Delegation follows your requests and applicable project or skill instructions. New launches capture model settings; existing agents keep their captured model.

enabled.label: Enable subagents
enabled.description: Make agent tools available. Turning this off prevents new launches; running agents remain available to inspect or stop.

concurrency.label: Maximum concurrent managed agents
concurrency.description: Maximum spawned agents across one root session and its descendants, excluding the root. Default: {{default}}. The extension task capacity also applies.
concurrency.taskCapacity: Configured extension task capacity: {{capacity}} tasks. Available child slots depend on running tasks.

defaultModel.label: Default subagent model
defaultModel.description: Leave blank to inherit the parent's model. Uses the parent's provider and credentials. Explicit launch choices override this default; custom agent settings take precedence.

defaultReasoning.label: Default subagent reasoning effort
defaultReasoning.description: Inherit the parent's reasoning effort when the model is inherited, or the model's default when a model is explicitly selected. Availability depends on the selected model.

interruptMessage.label: Record agent interruption messages
interruptMessage.description: Add a model-visible interruption note to the child thread when its turn is interrupted. Enabled by default.

types.title: Custom agents
types.description: Define named agents with a description, model, reasoning effort, and developer instructions. Custom settings override launch defaults. Agents inherit the parent's provider, permissions, and workspace scope.
types.name: New agent type name
types.nameHint: Use a lowercase letter first, then lowercase letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens; maximum 64 characters.

validation.concurrency: Choose a positive whole number for concurrent agents.
validation.model: Use a model identifier of at most 256 characters.
validation.reasoning: Choose a supported reasoning effort or Inherit.
validation.agentTypes: Use at most 24 valid agent types. Each needs a lowercase type name (up to 64 characters), a description of 1–500 characters, a supported role, and valid saved overrides.
validation.newType: Enter a unique valid type name and a description of 1–500 characters before adding it.
